scripts.check: vp run check:web && vp run check:worker && vp run test && vp run check:go && vp run build
scripts.test: vp run test:go && vp run test:web && vp run test:worker && vp run test:release
scripts.test:db: vp exec node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL test database'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test:voiceprints:air: vp run test:db && VOICES_AIR_TEST=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run TestVoiceprintAir -count=1 -v
scripts.test:voiceprints:browser: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run TestVoiceprintBrowser -count=1 -v -timeout=5m
scripts.test:ui: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^TestInteractionBrowser$' -count=1 -v -timeout=5m
scripts.test:references: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^TestReferencesBrowser$' -count=1 -v -timeout=12m
scripts.test:transcript: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^TestTranscript(Search|Navigation)Browser$' -count=1 -v -timeout=15m
scripts.test:recovery: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^TestJobRecoveryBrowser$' -count=1 -v -timeout=5m
scripts.test:e2e: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^(TestAdministrationInsightsBrowser|TestAdministrationBrowser|TestAccountFiltersBrowser|TestBrowserFullStack|TestAccountsBrowserFullStack|TestInterfaceLanguageBrowser|TestLLMModelsBrowser|TestServerSettingsBrowser|TestUpdatesBrowser|TestOnboardingBrowser|TestOnboardingRevisionBrowser|TestOnboardingSkipBrowser|TestInteractionBrowser|TestJobRecoveryBrowser|TestCallLogsBrowser|TestReferencesBrowser|TestTranscriptNavigationBrowser|TestTranscriptSearchBrowser|TestLoadingBrowser|TestOIDCBrowser|TestVoiceprintBrowser)$' -count=1 -v -timeout=60m
scripts.test:calls: vp run test:db && vp run build && VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ./scripts/go.sh test ./internal/app -run '^TestCallLogsBrowser$' -count=1 -v -timeout=12m
